title: App Development Workflow
definition: The series of steps and processes used to create, test, and distribute a software application.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine you're baking a cake. You need to write the recipe (code), test it (debug), and then share it (deploy) with others.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: App development workflow involves various stages such as planning, design, coding, testing, and deployment. It can be simplified or complicated based on the tools and technologies used.
difficulty_levels.expert: The app development workflow is a complex interplay of human, technical, and organizational factors. It's influenced by Agile, Waterfall, and other methodologies. It also intersects with fields like UX/UI design, project management, and software engineering.

extra_fields.insight: The conversation highlights the complexity of app development workflow, with different tools and technologies requiring different numbers of open windows or terminals.
